decisive_spans.text: Structures covered by swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules

response.rationale: D1 is strongly supported by multiple histopathological findings, including the presence of ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures and swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules. D5 is also supported by similar findings, but D1 has more specific support for the papillary structures and endothelial cell characteristics.
